description: This Java class 'EmbeddableProgressiveLoanScheduleGenerator' is part of the Apache Fineract project, specifically related to loan schedule generation within the 'loanaccount' domain. It appears to serve as an embeddable component for generating loan repayment schedules with progressive features. The class uses various calculators and generators to produce loan schedules and includes an internal static class that implements the 'InterestScheduleModelRepositoryWrapper' interface with default behavior.

classes.name: EmbeddableProgressiveLoanScheduleGenerator
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating loan repayment schedules with progressive features, utilizing embedded calculators and generators.

classes.name: NoopInterestScheduleModelRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A static inner class implementing 'InterestScheduleModelRepositoryWrapper' with default, no-operation behaviors.

methods.description: Generates a loan schedule plan based on the provided mathematical context and model data.
